content.text:
Act as the implementation sub-agent for this task.

Repo indkhan/Moneo. Work on GitHub issue #243 (read it with `gh issue view 243`, and AGENTS.md). Owner's decisions: stage `noUncheckedIndexedAccess` through a separate tsconfig that only covers the migrated folders; lib/finance and lib/bank first; never add non-null assertions (`!`) to silence errors; handle each real absent-value case properly (early return, default, Zod at the boundary, or a typed helper); no formatter in this work.

This PR is the first stage, `lib/bank/` only (lib/finance is being edited by another open PR right now, so leave it for the next stage). Steps:
1. Create branch `t3/issue-243-indexed-access` from origin/main. Recount: run `npx tsc --noEmit --noUncheckedIndexedAccess` and report non-test error counts per top-level folder in the PR body.
2. Add e.g. `tsconfig.indexed.json` that extends `tsconfig.json`, sets `noUncheckedIndexedAccess: true`, and includes only `lib/bank/**` (tests included or excluded, your call, say which). Note that files outside the include set that lib/bank imports are type-checked too; if that pulls in errors from other folders, find a way to report only lib/bank errors or narrow the setting, and explain.
3. Wire it into `npm run typecheck` so CI enforces it (CI runs `npm run typecheck`).
4. Fix every lib/bank error without `!` and without behaviour changes. Keep mechanical fixes in separate commits from any behavioural fix; if you find a real bug (a value that can actually be absent and was mishandled), fix it in its own commit with a test that fails before the fix, and name it in the PR body.
5. Add a lint or config guard if `!` could creep back in for these files (e.g. `@typescript-eslint/no-non-null-assertion` for `lib/bank/**`), and an AGENTS.md rules-table row for the staged setting with how to add the next folder.

Rules: run `npm test`, `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build` yourself and quote their last lines. Tests use only the moneo-qa test backend; never the owner's backend (.env, Docker project `moneo`, port 3000). Bank calls cost money and count against PSD2 limits: mock them. Never run `qa:reset` or `docker compose -p moneo-qa down`. Never kill a process you didn't start (verify by PID). Don't end your turn while a command is still running. No comments in code. Commits end with "Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>". Before opening the PR, merge origin/main. Open the PR (body ends with "🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)"), never merge it. Final line: PR <full URL>, head <SHA>.

Parent tracker: #224

**Priority:** P3 (incremental follow-up).

## Problem and current evidence

The audit reported 584 non-test errors under noUncheckedIndexedAccess and 2,361 source lines over 200 characters. These are maintenance improvements, not evidence of 584 confirmed runtime bugs.

## Scope

Recount first. Introduce checked indexed access in manageable areas or through a staged compiler target, resolving actual absent-value cases without adding non-null assertions to silence errors. Choose one formatter consistent with existing tooling rather than adding max-len churn and a competing formatter. Keep mechanical changes separate from behavioural changes.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The selected compiler boundary rejects unchecked possibly missing values.
- [ ] Boundary validation replaces unsafe assertions where data can be absent.
- [ ] Formatting is reproducible locally and in CI.
- [ ] Mechanical changes are isolated for review and do not change behaviour.
- [ ] Document a staged migration and keep full test/typecheck/build checks green.

## Verification and constraints

Reproduce the current behaviour before changing it. Run the smallest relevant check during implementation, then npm test, npm run lint and npm run typecheck; add a build for app/config changes and real QA browser verification for changed user flows. Use only disposable moneo-qa services, synthetic records and mocked paid integrations. Verify source installation and desktop compatibility. Preserve financial history, corrections and undo. Do not add prose or comments in place of a deterministic boundary.

## Delivery

This issue records follow-up work; it does not claim the change is implemented. Recheck current main and #224 before starting, since the audit counts may have changed. Keep the PR focused and link its checks and relevant evidence here.
